name: Asset Registry
description: The portfolio's asset catalog: native coins and tokens by CAIP-style identifier, with display metadata and price-source mapping.

global.schema:
type AssetRegistryState {
  assets: [Asset!]!
}

type Asset {
  id: OID!
  identifier: String!
  symbol: String!
  name: String!
  decimals: Int!
  kind: AssetKind!
  chainId: Int!
  coingeckoId: String
  underlying: String
  custom: Boolean!
  addedAt: DateTime!
}

enum AssetKind {
  NATIVE
  ERC20
  POSITION
  DEBT
}

operations.name: REGISTER_ASSET

errors.name: DuplicateAssetError
errors.description: An asset with the same identifier is already registered

operations.schema:
input RegisterAssetInput {
  id: OID!
  identifier: String!
  symbol: String!
  name: String!
  decimals: Int!
  kind: AssetKind!
  chainId: Int!
  coingeckoId: String
  underlying: String
  custom: Boolean!
  addedAt: DateTime!
}

operations.name: UPDATE_ASSET

errors.name: AssetNotFoundError
errors.description: No asset with that identifier exists

operations.schema:
input UpdateAssetInput {
  identifier: String!
  symbol: String
  name: String
  decimals: Int
  kind: AssetKind
  underlying: String
}

operations.name: SET_COINGECKO_ID

errors.name: AssetNotFoundError
errors.description: No asset with that identifier exists

operations.name: REMOVE_ASSET

errors.name: AssetNotFoundError
errors.description: No asset with that identifier exists

errors.name: NotCustomAssetError
errors.description: Only custom (locally registered) assets can be removed
